_comment: tools/t2_remake_stage.py: the Remake's recipes, the old fork's tools/data/t2_stages.json (the stage-engine.zip export) as they were: "arcade" a stage's by its fighter's key, "owners" / "fighters" that key's Tekken 2 stage and fighter (BNS group), "stages" the names.
_wolf_cut: tools/t2_remake_stages.py cut_fitted(): these stages ("arcade" keys) lose top cell rows of their background (as few as fit) rather than put pictures on Unknown's wolf and leave room for the overlay's letters while Unknown fights (the user's, 2026-11-05: Szechwan, Hong Kong, Akihabara, Great Wall, Launch Pad, Kyoto; Arizona for the letters). A key taken out: that stage built as before, the wolf's area when it does not fit without it. Since 2026-11-08 (the user's) only in the pack drawn while Unknown fights (stageNNw.ast, wolf_name()); stageNN.ast keeps the whole background, the wolf's area too, the letters' room (FONT_ROOM) free (full_fitted()); Hong Kong's whole does not fit: its one pack cut.
_own_frame: tools/t2_remake_stages.py convert(): these stages ("arcade" keys, the old fork's last five, exported 2026-11-07) are built in their own frame, the recipe as the old fork's (no Classic frame, no "frames"; the user's, 2026-11-07); a "wolf_cut" one of them loses top cell rows of its picture as own_cutter() cuts them. Hills (alex) "yoff" 16, not the old fork's 6: its picture's foot (the meadow) down on the floor's far edge, no flat green of the bottom colour under it (the user's, 2026-11-08; measured headless: 14 the least with none).
_frames: tools/t2_remake_stage.py classic_cfg(): the old in-game panorama (from the user's picture, measured once, 2026-11-04) against the Classic frame's (Tekken 2's panorama, its rows twice): its x times new width / old width after the turn "shift", its y to a * y + b ("y"); "old" its size, "hd" the user's picture's (the recipes' "crop" is in it); "lift" texels the picture higher in the frame, its foot out of the floor (London's buses, the user's, 2026-11-08)
